app.name: Kamo
app.tagline: Hit record. Click. Stop. It's already edited.

project.count: {count, plural, =0 {No projects yet} one {# project} other {# projects}}

projects.title: Recent projects
projects.empty: Nothing here yet. Hit Record and your first video lands right here.
projects.deleteConfirm: Move “{name}” to the trash? You can restore it from there.

broken.title: Damaged project
broken.unreadable: Kamo couldn't read this project's edits. The raw video may still be fine.
broken.newerVersion: Made with a newer version of Kamo. Update the app to open it.

errors.invalidName: A name needs at least one character (120 at most).

home.noDisplays: No display found. Is a monitor connected?
home.needsPermission: Kamo needs permission to record the screen. Allow it in System Settings.

audio.title: Sound
audio.micDenied: Kamo can't use the microphone. Allow it in your system settings; until then, recordings have no voice.
audio.micUnavailable: No microphone found. Recordings will have no voice.
audio.systemUnavailable: Kamo can't capture the computer sound right now. Recordings will have no computer sound.

camera.title: Camera
camera.name: Camera {index}
camera.denied: Kamo can't use the camera. Allow it in your system settings; until then, recordings have no camera.
camera.unavailable: No camera found, or another app is using it. Recordings will have no camera.

errors.helperMissing: Recording isn't available in this build yet: the capture helper is missing.
errors.lowDisk: Less than 1 GB free on this disk. Free up some space and try again.
errors.displayNotFound: That display isn't connected anymore. Pick another one.
errors.permissionDenied: Kamo needs permission to record the screen.
errors.tooShort: That was less than a second, so nothing was saved.
errors.displayLost: The display was disconnected. Kamo saved what it recorded.
errors.diskFull: The disk filled up. Kamo saved what it recorded.
errors.failed: Recording stopped unexpectedly. Kamo will try to recover it next time.

recording.saved: Saved. The editor arrives in the next version.

audio.micUnavailable: Saved without your voice: Kamo couldn't use the microphone.
audio.micLost: The microphone was disconnected while recording. The audio is silent from that point on.
audio.systemUnavailable: Saved without computer sound: Kamo couldn't capture it.
audio.failed: Saved, but some of the audio couldn't be kept.

camera.unavailable: Saved without the camera: Kamo couldn't use it.
camera.lost: The camera was disconnected while recording. The camera stops at that point.
camera.failed: Saved, but the camera recording couldn't be kept.

notice.title: Kamo is still running
notice.body: Kamo is in the system tray. Click its icon to open it, or right-click it to quit.

webcam.title: Webcam
webcam.dragHint: Or drag the bubble in the video to place it anywhere
webcam.layoutHint: Split stacks the screen over the camera in the vertical 9:16 format.
webcam.splitHint: Drag the line between the screen and the camera in the video to resize them.
webcam.splitOtherFormats: Split shows in 9:16. In 16:9 and 1:1 the camera stays a bubble.
webcam.dividerHint: Drag to resize the screen and the camera
webcam.hiddenHint: Drag to move, pull an edge to resize. Arrows nudge it, Delete shows the webcam again.

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.trimTooShort: Keep at least 1 second of video.
timeline.zoomBlockHint: Drag to move, pull an edge to resize. Arrows nudge it, Delete removes it, Enter changes the scale.

window.title: Window
window.closeToTray: Keep Kamo in the tray when the window is closed
window.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window leaves Kamo running in the system tray. To quit, right-click its icon and choose Quit Kamo.
window.closeToTrayHintMac: Closing the window leaves Kamo running with an icon in the menu bar. To quit, choose Quit Kamo there or press ⌘Q.

folders.title: Folders
folders.projectsHint: New recordings are saved here. Projects you already have stay where they are.

errors.busy: Finish the recording before changing the projects folder.
errors.notWritable: Kamo can't save in that folder. Pick another one.
errors.failed: Couldn't change the folder. Try again.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.stopHint: Works from any app while Kamo is recording. Kamo never reads what you type.
shortcuts.saved: Saved. It works from the next recording.

errors.needsModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt or ⌘ to the key. Shift alone would get in the way of typing.
errors.unsupported: That key can't be part of a shortcut.
errors.taken: Another app is already using {shortcut}. Try a different one.
errors.invalid: That shortcut doesn't work. Try a different one.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.none: Kamo doesn't need any system permission on this computer.
permissions.cameraHint: To show your webcam in the recording. Optional.
permissions.inputMonitoringHint: macOS says “keys”, but Kamo only reads the mouse and never sees what you type.

status.idle: Kamo checks for updates when it opens and once a day.
status.upToDate: You're on the latest version (checked at {time}).
status.ready: Version {version} is ready. Restart Kamo to finish.
status.error: Couldn't check for updates. Are you online?
status.unsupported: Updates only work in the installed app.

help.title: Help
help.description: Something went wrong? Kamo has no telemetry, so the details only travel if you send them.

about.title: About
about.license: Free and open source, under the MIT License.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: This is exactly what will be copied. Nothing is sent automatically: you decide where to paste it.
diagnostics.label: Diagnostics text
diagnostics.failed: Couldn't gather the diagnostics. Try again.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
diagnostics.openIssueHint: Opens GitHub in your browser with this text filled in. Nothing is posted until you submit it there.
diagnostics.openIssueFailed: Couldn't open the browser. Copy the text and paste it into a GitHub issue.

updates.busy: Kamo is recording or exporting. Restart when it's done.

welcome.title: Hi, I'm Kamo.
welcome.body: Before your first take, let's check what your computer needs to let me record. It takes about a minute.

screen.title: Let Kamo see your screen
screen.why: macOS asks before any app records the screen. Without this one Kamo can't record anything, so it's the only one you can't skip.

microphone.title: Want your voice in the videos?
microphone.why: With the microphone, Kamo records your narration together with the screen. You can skip this and allow it later.

inputMonitoring.title: Let Kamo follow your clicks
inputMonitoring.why: Kamo zooms in where you click, so it needs to see the mouse.
inputMonitoring.keyboardNote: macOS calls this “keys”, but Kamo only reads the mouse and never sees what you type.

onboarding.detecting: Kamo notices on its own when you allow it.

deniedHelp.mac: Turn Kamo on in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then come back here.
deniedHelp.windows: In Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone, turn on microphone access and “Let desktop apps access your microphone”.

onboarding.reopenHint: Already allowed it? macOS sometimes only notices after Kamo reopens.
onboarding.reopenFailed: Couldn't reopen now. Close Kamo and open it again.

done.title: All set.
done.body: Pick a screen, hit Record and click around. Kamo takes care of the zooms.

export.title: Export
export.laterNote: 4K, 60 fps and GIF arrive in a coming version, free like everything else.

done.title: {count, plural, one {# file saved} other {# files saved}}
done.subtitle: Done. It's already edited.

errors.title: The export stopped
errors.disk_full: The disk is full. The incomplete file was deleted; free up some space and try again.
errors.write_failed: Kamo could not write the file. The incomplete file was deleted.
errors.source_unreadable: Kamo could not read this recording's video.
errors.encoder_unavailable: This computer has no H.264 encoder Kamo can use.
errors.failed: Something went wrong while exporting. The incomplete file was deleted.

warnings.software_encoder: This computer has no hardware video encoder, so the export used the slower software one.
warnings.audio_unreadable: A sound track could not be read, so it was left out.
warnings.audio_encoder_unavailable: This computer cannot encode AAC sound, so the video has no sound.
warnings.webcam_unreadable: The webcam recording could not be read, so the video has no webcam bubble.

closeDialog.title: Export in progress
closeDialog.message: Closing now cancels the export and deletes the unfinished file.

recovery.found: We found an interrupted recording from {date}.
recovery.discardConfirm: Move this recording to the trash? You can restore it from there.
recovery.unrecoverable: None of the video can be played, so it can't be recovered.
